title: Be Strong
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s lesson you will see 
that the Lord tells
JOSHUA
to be strong and courageous

Joshua is the new leader as Moses has died.
Joshua has to be in charge now.
He must not be afraid.
The Lord tells him to be strong.

BUT WHAT DOES THAT MEAN?
Let’s us see who else was STRONG and COURAGEOUS in the BIBLE

So being strong isn’t about big muscles
Being strong is about trusting God 
and doing what He wants you to do

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for dying on the cross for me
Please make me brave and strong
Amen
